checks: Anonymous standalone cart create/select/rename/duplicate/delete, including deleting the last cart and starting again
Browser save/edit/reload with no account API writes; saved money reconstructed locally
Guest prices and output proofs match the shared validator for ECS pay-per-use/period/RI, Flexus L, ELB, OBS and one-time billing
Cart and project JSON imports are atomic; project imports create independent carts
JSON downloads validate and import into an authenticated account project with the same price
Unicode compressed sharing, fresh recipient IDs, preserved existing carts and authenticated recipients
Recipient edits leave sender data unchanged; reload does not reimport the shared cart
Clipboard cut/paste and queued configurations without account writes
Invalid import/share data, corrupt storage recovery, quota failures and conflicting tabs preserve existing data
Existing calculator, API, schema popup and action menu regressions
All published default service/region/billing combinations validated
TypeScript, production build and lint with three pre-existing warnings
Private test application uses an internal Docker network; no upstream runtime dependency
Live HTTPS anonymous save/reload/JSON export validation, share-link copy, mobile recipient editing/reload and schema popup with no production account writes, external requests or iframes

limits.sharing: Immutable copies, not live collaboration or revocable server records

scope: Standalone carts and shared pricing output. This does not repair outstanding daily-worker audit failures or establish exhaustive current upstream comparisons of all conditional branches.
